desired_performances: Given a basic drawing set, interpret the relevant elements and prepare a sequenced method proposal with stated safety considerations.

objectives.performance: Identify standard symbols, notation, and view types in a basic construction drawing set
conditions: Given a basic construction drawing set containing plan, elevation, and section views
success_criteria: Correctly names at least five standard drawing symbols or notation conventions without reference aids

assumption_notes: Learner prior drawing literacy is unconfirmed; if entry assessment confirms literacy this objective is a candidate for removal

objectives.performance: Extract and describe the spatial and technical elements relevant to a specified construction task from a basic drawing set
conditions: Given a basic multi-view construction drawing set and a stated construction task
success_criteria: Identifies which drawing views and annotations are relevant to the task
Correctly describes dimensions, materials, or sequence indicators present in the drawings

assumption_notes: Relevance judgment is scoped to the stated task; no domain expertise beyond drawing literacy is assumed

objectives.performance: Prepare a sequenced method proposal with explicitly stated safety considerations derived from a basic construction drawing set
conditions: Given a basic construction drawing set and a specified construction task
success_criteria: Produces a method proposal with work steps in a logical sequence consistent with the drawing information
States at least one safety consideration per major work phase traceable to drawing-readable information

assumption_notes: Method proposal is scoped to a brief sequenced description of work steps; formal contractual method statement format is not assumed
Safety considerations are limited to those derivable from drawing content; construction-regulation knowledge is out of scope for this objective

dependency_candidates.capability: basic spatial reasoning for multi-view drawings
dependency_candidates.reason: Interpreting spatial relationships across plan, elevation, and section views requires spatial reasoning that may need prior activation; this is supporting knowledge not directly demonstrated by any supplied objective and has not been confirmed in the learner state

dependency_candidates.capability: generic familiarity with construction work phase concepts
dependency_candidates.reason: Sequencing a method proposal presupposes some conceptual familiarity with what constitutes a work phase; this is candidate supporting knowledge for lo-3 but is not directly derivable from drawing content alone and is not assessed by any supplied objective

prerequisites.capability: basic spatial reasoning for multi-view drawings
prerequisites.rationale: Supports lo-2 and asmnt-lo2-formative by enabling spatial interpretation across plan, elevation, and section views. However, lo-1 instruction introduces and names those view types, providing a scaffolding opportunity within the course before lo-2 is reached. No evidence that this capability must exist and be confirmed before course entry; the in-course progression from lo-1 (recognition) to lo-2 (analysis) provides a reasonable scaffold path. ENTRY_PREREQUISITE disposition is not warranted without learner-population evidence that basic spatial reasoning cannot be activated in-course.
source_dependency_refs: dependency_candidate:basic spatial reasoning for multi-view drawings

prerequisites.capability: generic familiarity with construction work phase concepts
prerequisites.rationale: Supports lo-3 and asmnt-lo3-summative by providing conceptual grounding for sequencing a method proposal into phases. The supplied dependency candidate notes this knowledge is not derivable from drawing content alone, but that does not preclude brief in-course introduction as supporting instructional content ahead of the lo-3 task. No evidence this must be confirmed before entry; in-course introduction is preferred. ENTRY_PREREQUISITE disposition would require evidence that the lo-3 instructional window is insufficient to introduce this concept.

planning_warnings.rationale: The three supplied assessment time requirements (15 + 20 + 25 = 60 min) consume the entire declared 60-minute budget. No minutes are available for instruction, guided practice, independent practice, or feedback/revision. Practice coverage requirements for the lo-3 summative required capabilities cannot be met within the current budget. Optional enrichment scope has been suppressed. Only the three core objective-linked modules are retained. Researcher must adjudicate: either expand the declared total budget or remove scope to create non-assessment headroom before this outline can progress to lesson generation.

sequencing_rationale: Module 1 precedes Module 2 because the supplied lo-2 objective lists lo-1-recognize-drawing-conventions as a prerequisite; recognition of symbols and view types must be established before analysis tasks are introduced.

Module 2 precedes Module 3 because the supplied lo-3 objective lists lo-2-interpret-drawing-elements as a prerequisite; element extraction and relevance judgment are prerequisite competencies for method proposal preparation.

prereq-01-spatial-reasoning carries an in-course support disposition in the supplied prerequisites artifact; Module 1 view-type recognition content is intended to scaffold spatial reasoning before learners reach the Module 2 analysis task, consistent with that disposition.

prereq-02-work-phase-familiarity carries an in-course support disposition in the supplied prerequisites artifact; Module 3 is the intended site for brief in-course introduction of work-phase concepts ahead of the lo-3 sequencing task, consistent with that disposition.
No reordering of modules is warranted; the linear prerequisite chain lo-1 → lo-2 → lo-3 is the only sequence consistent with all supplied objective prerequisite_refs.

assumption_notes: Module IDs are model-generated identifiers; researcher should confirm or replace per project naming conventions.
Module estimated_minutes equal the corresponding assessment time allocations from the supplied assessments artifact; they do not represent verified instructional time splits.
The scope_time_conflict planning warning is a mandatory disclosure of a budget constraint, not a resolved design decision; researcher adjudication is required before lesson generation.
All objective_ids and prerequisite_refs are copied exactly from the supplied allow-list; no identifiers have been invented.
